title: What AI has changed in Design Systems, and what is still up to us
description: Expert insights reveal how AI is transforming design system creation and maintenance while identifying the irreplaceable human elements that still require intentional design thinking. A timely exploration of where automation adds value and where human judgment remains essential.

title: Design by numbers: is AI ruining UX or just pouring gasoline on the fire?
description: A critical examination of whether AI will replace UX designers, arguing that the real question isn't about replacement but about how designers evolve their role in an AI-augmented world. This essay challenges industry panic and reframes the conversation around intentional design choices.

title: AI can generate the interface. What makes it worth caring about?
description: Explores the philosophical shift in UX design as AI handles boilerplate interfaces—designers must now decide where experiences should delight, surprise, or provide quiet functionality. This perspective helps teams prioritize meaningful design decisions over routine pattern application.

title: Designing a skill
description: An insightful essay positioning AI skills as the emerging app layer of the agentic era, arguing that traditional software design principles apply directly to skill development. Essential reading for designers adapting to AI-driven product development.

title: Everyone's got a quick question
description: A relatable examination of how one person becomes the de facto team search engine, exploring the organizational UX problem of information asymmetry and inefficient knowledge-sharing patterns. Offers practical insights into team dynamics and communication design.

title: Nubank: Rebrand
description: A comprehensive case study of Nubank's brand redesign and digital foundations, demonstrating how strategic design systems can reduce complexity while maintaining brand distinctiveness. Practical inspiration for teams managing large-scale design transformations.

title: In a world of panic, calm and certainty win
description: A motivational essay encouraging designers to move beyond anxiety about AI and actively shape the industry's future through intentional choices and leadership. Timely perspective on building confidence and agency amid technological disruption.

title: Mean
description: An innovative tool for visual handoff that bridges human and AI collaboration by enabling screen recording with gesture annotations and seamless agent integration. Represents practical progress in solving the handoff problem between designers, developers, and AI systems.
